Name: Junimo Kart Prizes
Author: b1rdyw1rdy
Description:
[size=2]This mod adds prizes for Junimo Kart that can be redeemed based on the coins and fruit collected. Each fruit collected is worth 10 coins.

In the config file, the Junimo Kart prize rarities can be changed. The mod checks the rarity values from most valuable to least valuable where 0 = 0% and 1 = 100%. So for example, if you set the rare, epic and legendary rarity value to 1, then legendary prizes will show up 100% of the time while the epic and rare prizes will show up 0% of the time. If you then set the legendary value to 0, then the epic prizes will show up 100% of the time.

I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] if you are interested in editing the config. If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] installed, you can click the cog button (⚙) on the main menu to get to the mod settings.[/size]

[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [i]StardewValley/Mods[/i]
[*]Run the game using [i][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/i][/i]
[i]
[/i][/list][size=4]Compatibility:[/size][list]
[*][size=2]This mod is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿.[/size]
[/list]
